records.caption:
Your bare rental wall is begging for a woodland escape.

Blank walls feel cold, and you can't paint a rental without risking your deposit. This peel-and-stick wallpaper covers it in a vintage woodland print of rust-toned mushrooms and green ferns. No paste, no paint, and it's removable when you move, so your bedroom turns into a cozy little forest hideaway.

• Mirrored mushroom and fern print in earthy rust, olive and cream
• 17.7 x 118 in (45 x 300 cm) roll, or a 12 x 12 in sample
• Peel-and-stick PVC vinyl, felt-edge squeegee included

Link in the first comment. From $14.99 on Etsy.

records.caption:
Tired of baked goods sticking and tearing apart?

Stuck-on cookies and cakes ruin the fun of baking, and scrubbing pans is a chore. This non-stick silicone mat lets every bake lift off cleanly with no oil or butter, then rinses clean in seconds. Just golden treats sliding right off the tray.

• Non-stick, BPA-free silicone, no greasing needed
• Heat resistant up to 230°C (446°F)
• Thin 0.4 mm mat with circle guides for even cookies and macarons

Link in the first comment. ¥1,980 (about $12 USD).
